note: THREE clips, not one. 06/IMG_9265 is the 1080p sit-down; 04/IMG_8823 and 01/IMG_8814 are 4K solo shots of Eden from earlier the same afternoon and are the better picture, so her strongest answers come from those. Order is the STORY: the ask, who she is, her mother, how hard it is, why she chooses to live, the strength, belief, the message, the last word. autoFrame is OFF - it locked onto Tal's face (nearer the lens) and cut Eden off at the right edge while she was speaking. xc per beat instead: 06 is a two-shot, Tal LEFT and Eden RIGHT; 01 and 04 are Eden alone, centre-left.
beats: 'Hi Eden. I heard about your story - you have cancer and you are not giving up. I wanted to come and hear it.'
'Can I sit down and listen?' - 'Of course.'
'I'm Eden, I'm 30, and I've been fighting leukemia for a year.'
'I lost my mother a year ago.' - 'You lost your mother a year ago?'
'How did she pass away?' - 'She passed away from cancer.'
'How long did she have cancer?' - '17 years.'
4K. THE TURN. 'I'm happy to live my life, because I can't keep on crying. It isn't good and it isn't healthy.'
4K. 'How do you stay so strong?' - 'It's not easy. But I'm not afraid of anything.'
4K. 'Do you believe in yourself?' - 'Yes.' - 'Do you know how many people believe in you?' - 'Yes.'
'What is your dream?' - 'Come and visit. I would be very happy.'
THE MESSAGE. 'You can be upset, you can be sad - but don't go straight down. Know how to lift yourself up.'
THE LAST WORD. 'I will be stronger.'
